dimensions.assessment: Directly impacts Indian tribes, tribal organizations, and Native Hawaiian organizations engaged in tourism and visitor experience initiatives.
dimensions.evidence: authorize grants to Indian tribes, tribal organizations, and Native Hawaiian organizations

dimensions.assessment: Provides grant funding opportunities for tourism-related projects and administrative agreements without imposing sweeping mandates.
dimensions.evidence: activities related to recreational travel and tourism

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes $35,000,000 in federal appropriations for the period of fiscal years 2025 through 2029.
dimensions.evidence: There is authorized to be appropriated to carry out this section $35,000,000 for the period of fiscal years 2025 through 2029.

dimensions.assessment: Expands the Native American Tourism and Improving Visitor Experience Act to authorize grant-making authority across multiple federal agencies and offices.
dimensions.evidence: The Director of the Bureau of Indian Affairs may make grants... The Director of the Office of Native Hawaiian Relations may make grants... Heads of other Federal agencies... may make grants

dimensions.assessment: Applies through a defined five-year authorization window spanning fiscal years 2025 through 2029.
dimensions.evidence: for the period of fiscal years 2025 through 2029

importance_detail.rationale: The bill authorizes $35 million in appropriations for tourism and recreational travel grants to Indian tribes, tribal organizations, and Native Hawaiian organizations over a multi-year period.
